CREATE TABLE `bookings` (
  `id` varchar(36) NOT NULL,
  `booking_number` varchar(50) NOT NULL,
  `customer_id` varchar(36) NOT NULL,
  `vendor_id` varchar(36) NOT NULL,
  `service_id` varchar(36) DEFAULT NULL,
  `package_id` varchar(36) DEFAULT NULL,
  `event_date` date NOT NULL,
  `guest_count` int(11) DEFAULT 200,
  `total_amount` decimal(12,2) NOT NULL,

  `cancellation_reason` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `notes` text DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime DEFAULT current_timestamp(),
  `updated_at` datetime DEFAULT current_timestamp() ON UPDATE current_timestamp(),
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `booking_number` (`booking_number`),
  KEY `customer_id` (`customer_id`),

  KEY `idx_bookings_status` (`status`),

  CONSTRAINT `bookings_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`customer_id`) REFERENCES `customer_profiles` (`id`),
  CONSTRAINT `bookings_ibfk_2` FOREIGN KEY (`vendor_id`) REFERENCES `vendors` (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
